sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正为你们带来终极《办公室》重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会剖析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。
我觉得是因为天气太热了。

sentences.en: I'm wearing one of those dresses that doesn't touch you anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我穿了一条那种完全不贴身的裙子。

sentences.en: I never do that when we record.
sentences.zh: 录音的时候我从不穿人字拖。

sentences.en: Oh, I wear them all the time.
Yeah, look at my feet right now.
Well, now that you know what we're wearing, Jenna, what are you wearing?
sentences.zh: 好了，既然你知道我们穿什么了，珍娜，你穿的是什么？

sentences.en: I am wearing these, like, black, what would you call them?
sentences.zh: 我穿的是这种黑色的，该怎么形容呢？

sentences.en: They're like the big leg pants.
sentences.zh: 就像那种大裤腿的裤子。

sentences.en: Well, these are, like, my find of the year.
sentences.zh: 这可是我今年的心头好。

sentences.en: A mom friend of mine, she's French.
sentences.zh: 我有个妈妈朋友，她是法国人。

sentences.en: She has the cutest pants all the time.
sentences.zh: 她总是穿着最可爱的裤子。

sentences.en: She told me about them, and they're very cool.
sentences.zh: 她告诉了我这个牌子，真的很棒。

sentences.en: And then I have on a cool billowy black top to go with it.
sentences.zh: 我还搭了一件很酷的飘逸黑色上衣。

sentences.en: I'm in a big, flowy dress from Tarragut.
sentences.zh: 我穿的是一件来自Tarragut的大号飘逸裙子。

sentences.en: So, now that we've got that out of the way, what are we talking about today?
sentences.zh: 好了，既然这些都处理完了，我们今天聊什么呢？

sentences.en: I was so excited for these storylines.
sentences.zh: 我对这些剧情线感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Is it any surprise that we love this episode now that our characters finally have stories again?
sentences.zh: 我们的角色终于又有了故事，我们喜欢这一集难道还奇怪吗？

sentences.en: Could that be part of it?
Maybe it's because our characters make it better.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为我们的角色让它变得更精彩了。

sentences.en: Well, we have it on very good authority from the writer's room.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们从编剧室那里得到了非常可靠的消息。
多点帕姆和安吉拉的戏份。

sentences.en: It's official, and this episode proves it.
sentences.zh: 这是官方认证的，这一集就证明了这一点。
我们要聊的是陪审团义务。

sentences.en: It's season eight, episode 13, written by Aaron Schur, who we love.
sentences.zh: 这是第八季第13集，由我们喜爱的亚伦·舒尔编剧。

sentences.en: Jim is back from jury duty.
sentences.zh: 吉姆结束陪审团义务回来了。

sentences.en: Turns out he was actually home helping Pam with the kids.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他其实一直待在家里帮帕姆照顾孩子。

sentences.en: Dwight figures this out and is determined to get Jim fired as a result.
sentences.zh: 德怀特发现了这一点，并决心因此让吉姆被解雇。

sentences.en: Also, Angela gives birth to a big, healthy preemie, which causes some speculation about timelines and paternity.
sentences.zh: 此外，安吉拉生下了一个又大又健康的早产儿，这引起了一些关于时间线和亲子关系的猜测。

sentences.en: And Pam brings CeCe and Philip into the office to visit.
sentences.zh: 帕姆带着西西和菲利普到办公室探班。

sentences.en: Fast fact number one, new director alert, Eric Appel.
sentences.zh: 速递事实第一条，新导演预警，埃里克·阿佩尔。

sentences.en: Eric has directed a ton of television.
sentences.zh: 埃里克执导过大量的电视节目。

sentences.en: His background is in animation and sketch comedy, and he did improv at the Upright Citizens Brigade.
sentences.zh: 他的背景是动画和素描喜剧，他还在“直立公民旅”做过即兴表演。

sentences.en: There's a scene between Dwight and Angela where he just let us go.
sentences.zh: 德怀特和安吉拉之间有一场戏，他完全让我们自由发挥。

sentences.en: I think I know which one.

sentences.zh: 因为我太喜欢那场戏了。

sentences.en: But Eric has been nominated for and won several awards for his work.
sentences.zh: 埃里克凭借他的作品获得过多次奖项提名并获奖。

sentences.en: According to his IMDb page under the trivia section, Eric can trifold his tongue.
sentences.zh: 根据他IMDb页面上的琐事部分，埃里克可以把舌头折成三折。

sentences.en: This is also sometimes referred to as a cloverleaf tongue.
sentences.zh: 这有时也被称为三叶草舌。
我不得不去谷歌了一下。

sentences.en: Is that where you make it look like a flower kind of thing?
sentences.zh: 就是那种让舌头看起来像朵花一样的东西吗？

sentences.en: I think it looks like a W, like you're making a W with your tongue.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它看起来像个W，就像你用舌头做出了一个W的形状。

sentences.en: While Googling what it was, I found out that Daniel Radcliffe can also do this.
sentences.zh: 在谷歌搜索它是什么的时候，我发现丹尼尔·雷德克里夫也能做到这一点。

sentences.en: And here, Daniel Radcliffe did it once on a red carpet.
sentences.zh: 你看，丹尼尔·雷德克里夫在红毯上就做过一次。
这就是丹尼尔·雷德克里夫的三折舌头。

sentences.en: According to an article on Colgate.com, 14.7% of the population can trifold their tongue.
sentences.zh: 根据Colgate.com上的一篇文章，14.7%的人口可以把舌头折成三折。
有人能把舌头折成三折吗？
她还得去谷歌搜索一下。

sentences.en: Cassie's looking it up to see if she can.
sentences.zh: 凯西正在查她自己能不能做到。

sentences.en: It really looks like a W.
Can you make a W out of your tongue?
sentences.zh: 你能用舌头做出W的形状吗？

sentences.en: I can do the canoe thing with my tongue.
sentences.zh: 我能用舌头做出独木舟的样子。

sentences.en: I can do the canoe fold.
And I can also fold my tongue in half like this.
sentences.zh: 而且我还能像这样把舌头对折。
那发出的声音太恶心了。

sentences.en: I had no idea we were going here this morning.
sentences.zh: 我没想到今天早上会聊到这个话题。

sentences.en: It's where my research took us.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的研究把我们带到的地方。

sentences.en: Would you like Fast Fact No.
sentences.zh: 你想要第二个速览事实吗？

sentences.en: 2 is a fan question from Tracy W.
sentences.zh: 2条是来自挪威的特蕾西·W的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: Jenna and Angela, I'm curious if you have ever had any interesting real-life personal experiences
sentences.zh: 珍娜和安吉拉，我很好奇你们是否有过任何有趣的现实生活经历
关于被传唤去担任陪审员的。

sentences.en: Tracy, I almost always get selected to be on a jury.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西，我几乎每次都会被选中担任陪审员。

sentences.en: I mean, every time I go in there, they're like, little blonde lady, get up here.
sentences.zh: 我是说，每次我进去，他们就像是，那个金发小个子女士，上来吧。

sentences.en: But yes, I have many stories of jury duty.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，我有很多关于陪审团职责的故事。

sentences.en: I think I've already shared one.
sentences.zh: 我想我已经分享过一个了。

sentences.en: Yeah, back when Toby had jury duty.
sentences.zh: 没错，就在托比去当陪审员的时候。

sentences.en: That was when I was a juror on a bait car case.
sentences.zh: 那是我在诱饵车案件中担任陪审员的时候。

sentences.en: But guess what I found in my digital clutter?
sentences.zh: 但你猜我在我的数字杂物里发现了什么？

sentences.en: And I didn't even know you had this question.
sentences.zh: 而且我甚至都不知道你问过这个问题。

sentences.en: I wrote you an email from one of the many times I was waiting to be, you know, picked for
sentences.zh: 我给你写过一封邮件，那是我等待被选中去当陪审员的

sentences.en: And I sent you a picture, too.
sentences.zh: 我还给你发了一张照片。

sentences.en: In the waiting room, guys, I wasn't in the courthouse, okay?
sentences.zh: 在候审室里，伙计们，我当时不在法庭里，好吗？

sentences.en: You're not allowed to do that in the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 在法庭里是不允许那样做的。

sentences.en: But in that holding room, you can.
sentences.zh: 但在那个等候室里，是可以的。
这是我发给你的邮件内容。

sentences.en: I'm waiting to see if I get picked for a jury.
sentences.zh: 我正在等候看是否会被选中去当陪审员。

sentences.en: I'm sitting in a big room with a bunch of people.
sentences.zh: 我正坐在一间大屋子里，和一群人在一起。

sentences.en: And we all have those chairs from high school that have a mini desk attached to them.
sentences.zh: 我们坐的都是那种高中里带小课桌的椅子。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm in a study hall at a school for random adults.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己就像是在一所面向随机成年人的自习室里。

sentences.en: I brought townhouse crackers and some cheese.
sentences.zh: 我带了汤豪斯饼干和一些奶酪。

sentences.en: And the guy next to me looks up every time I bite into a cracker.
sentences.zh: 我旁边的那个人每次我咬一口饼干，他都会抬头看我。

sentences.en: I also brought my laptop and have Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 我还带了笔记本电脑，而且有Wi-Fi。

sentences.en: So email away or leave me a message.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管发邮件或给我留言吧。

sentences.en: Why do you have such pretty hair for jury duty?
sentences.zh: 为什么你去当陪审员头发还弄得这么漂亮？

sentences.en: God, Angela, you brought cheese to jury duty.
sentences.zh: 天哪，安吉拉，你竟然带了奶酪去当陪审员。

sentences.en: And I took a selfie and you see me holding like a Ziploc of crackers.
sentences.zh: 我还自拍了一张，照片里你能看到我拿着一袋密封的饼干。

sentences.en: I was on jury duty the week we were prepping this episode to record.
sentences.zh: 就在我们准备录制这一集的那周，我正好在当陪审员。

sentences.en: So I was supposed to do jury duty.
sentences.zh: 我本来应该去履行陪审团义务的。

sentences.en: But I forgot to when I postponed it.
sentences.zh: 但我忘了自己是什么时候申请延期的。

sentences.en: And suddenly it popped up on my calendar.
sentences.zh: 突然它就在我的日历上弹出来了。

sentences.en: I got a reminder on the Sunday night before.
sentences.zh: 我在周日晚上收到了提醒。

sentences.en: My husband was out of town the whole week.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫那一整周都不在城里。

sentences.en: He had to go to Chicago.
And I was the only parent.
And I thought, oh my gosh, I can't.
What if I get picked for a jury?
sentences.zh: 万一我被选进陪审团了怎么办？

sentences.en: So I can't do jury duty.
sentences.zh: 所以我没法履行陪审义务。

sentences.en: So I go on the computer.
You log in with your juror ID number.
sentences.zh: 用你的陪审员编号登录就行。

sentences.en: And so I go to the portal and it says you can't postpone anymore.
sentences.zh: 我登录了网站，上面显示不能再延期了。

sentences.en: You had to do that by the Friday before.
sentences.zh: 必须在之前的周五前完成申请。

sentences.en: But it also said you don't have to report tomorrow, Monday.
sentences.zh: 但它也说周一不用去报到。

sentences.en: Check in again Monday evening to see if you have to report Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上再查一次，看周二是否需要报到。

sentences.en: So you just rolled the dice.
Every night at 7 p.m., I would log into my jury portal.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上七点，我都会登录陪审团门户网站。

sentences.en: And every night it said you don't have to report.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上它都显示不需要报到。

sentences.en: And then on Thursday night, it said you've completed your jury duty.
sentences.zh: 然后周四晚上，它显示我已经完成了陪审义务。

sentences.en: I mean, considering everything, you were like single parenting.
sentences.zh: 我是说，考虑到种种情况，你当时就像是在独自抚养孩子。

sentences.en: I will say, anyone that knows our mom detective hearts knows that we would actually be thrilled
sentences.zh: 我想说，任何了解我们那颗“侦探妈妈”心的人都知道，我们其实会很兴奋

sentences.en: to get picked under different circumstances.
sentences.zh: 能在不同情况下被选中。

sentences.en: I've reported many times and I've never been selected.
sentences.zh: 我报到过很多次，但从来没被选中过。

sentences.en: Oh, I always get selected and I get very excited.
sentences.zh: 噢，我总是被选中，而且我非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And I bring a notepad and a pen.
sentences.zh: 而且我会带上记事本和笔。

sentences.en: And some people know I'm serious.
sentences.zh: 有些人知道我是认真的。

sentences.en: Maybe that's why you're getting picked.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是你总被选中的原因。

sentences.en: Well, those are our jury duty stories.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是我们的陪审团故事。

sentences.en: Moving us now to Fast Fact 3.
sentences.zh: 现在进入第三个速览事实。

sentences.en: I titled it, Pam is Back.
sentences.zh: 我给它起名为：帕姆回归。

sentences.en: Everyone, I did this episode five weeks after having a C-section.
sentences.zh: 各位，我是在剖腹产五周后拍摄的这一集。

sentences.en: I did that because actors do not get paid maternity leave.
sentences.zh: 我之所以这么做，是因为演员没有带薪产假。

sentences.en: We go on unpaid disability, which means your employer can't fire you,
sentences.zh: 我们休的是无薪伤残假，这意味着雇主不能解雇你，

sentences.en: but they do not have to pay you.
sentences.zh: 但他们不必支付你工资。

sentences.en: So every time I missed an episode, I missed a paycheck.
sentences.zh: 所以每次我缺席一集拍摄，就意味着少了一份薪水。

sentences.en: I wrote about it in our book.
sentences.zh: 我在我们的书里写过这件事。

sentences.en: We got a lot of mail about this.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多关于此事的来信。

sentences.en: People who had read our book and were surprised to learn about this.
sentences.zh: 读过我们书的人对了解到这一点感到惊讶。

sentences.en: We got a fan question from Kathleen M.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一位来自北卡罗来纳州的凯瑟琳·M的粉丝提问，

sentences.en: In your book, The Office BFFs, Jenna shared about how hard it was for her to return and
sentences.zh: 在你们的书《办公室闺蜜》中，珍娜分享了她在生完孩子后回到剧组

sentences.en: film this episode after having her baby and how supportive everyone was.
sentences.zh: 拍摄这一集有多么困难，以及大家是如何支持她的。

sentences.en: I'd love to hear more about what it was like to film an episode of TV right after having your
sentences.zh: 我很想多了解一下，刚生完孩子就去拍摄电视剧是什么感觉，

sentences.en: baby and what was going through your head when filming these scenes.
sentences.zh: 以及你在拍摄这些场景时心里在想些什么。

sentences.en: Well, Kathleen, it was very, very hard.
sentences.zh: 嗯，凯瑟琳，那真的非常、非常困难。

sentences.en: I could not walk without pain.
sentences.zh: 我走路时感到疼痛难忍。

sentences.en: As you bleed a lot after you have a baby, it doesn't matter if it's C-section or vaginal.
sentences.zh: 因为生完孩子后确实会流很多血，不管是剖腹产还是顺产都一样。

sentences.en: I was still working with a lactation consultant trying to get my son to nurse well.
sentences.zh: 我当时还在咨询哺乳顾问，努力让儿子顺利吃奶。

sentences.en: I was very worried about messing up his feeding schedule.
sentences.zh: 我非常担心会打乱他的喂养时间表。

sentences.en: At the same time, coming back to work meant that I got to see all of these people who just
sentences.zh: 与此同时，回到工作岗位意味着我能见到所有那些非常爱我的人，

sentences.en: loved me so much, the cast and the crew, and I'd been very isolated at home.
sentences.zh: 包括演员和剧组工作人员，而我之前在家里一直很孤立。

sentences.en: Parents know this when you have a new baby.
sentences.zh: 有新生儿的父母都懂这种感觉。

sentences.en: We get letters from people who tell us we're keeping them company at home in those early
sentences.zh: 我们收到过很多来信，人们说我们在他们最初的那些日子里陪伴着他们，

sentences.en: I remember loving having friends that had a big time difference who were already awake.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时很庆幸有身处不同时区、已经醒着的朋友。

sentences.en: You know, my friends on the East Coast because I would be up at like 4 a.m.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如我在东海岸的朋友，因为我那时凌晨四点左右就会醒来。

sentences.en: And I knew I could call and just kind of talk to them while I breastfed.
sentences.zh: 我知道我可以给他们打电话，在哺乳的时候和他们聊聊天。

sentences.en: Well, the part of getting to see people, I loved that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，能见到人这一点，我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: That was good for my soul because I'd been very, like, in a cocoon, you know?
sentences.zh: 这对我的心灵很有治愈作用，因为我当时就像一直待在蚕茧里一样，你懂吗？

sentences.en: And then when we started filming, my adrenaline really kicked in.
sentences.zh: 后来我们开始拍摄时，我的肾上腺素真的飙升了。
那感觉简直像做梦一样。

sentences.en: I don't have any real memories that when I watched that scene, I feel like I dreamed
sentences.zh: 我没什么真实的记忆，看那场戏的时候，我觉得自己好像是梦到过

sentences.en: I was like, I guess I was there.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，我猜我当时确实在那儿吧。

sentences.en: So we also got another letter from Alexis Kaye in California who said,
sentences.zh: 我们还收到了一封来自加州 Alexis Kaye 的来信，她说：

sentences.en: Jenna, after listening to your experience in your book about coming back to work,
sentences.zh: Jenna，读了你书中关于产后重返职场的经历，

sentences.en: just five weeks after having your baby, I'm floored.
sentences.zh: 在生完孩子仅仅五周后就回去工作，我简直惊呆了。

sentences.en: I also had a C-section, and I can't imagine going back to work that quickly.
sentences.zh: 我也经历过剖腹产，我无法想象那么快就回去工作。

sentences.en: I am so in awe and just wanted to say that you looked amazing.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常佩服你，只是想说你当时看起来状态太棒了。

sentences.en: You looked peaceful, glowing, and at ease, although I'm sure you were so overwhelmed
sentences.zh: 你看上去平静、容光焕发且从容不迫，尽管我肯定你当时一定

sentences.en: You mentioned in the book that Angela and the rest of the cast and crew were really supportive.
sentences.zh: 你在书中提到 Angela 和其他演职人员都非常支持你。

sentences.en: What else helped you in those first weeks of going back to work?
sentences.zh: 在重返职场的最初几周，还有什么帮到了你吗？

sentences.en: Well, my husband, Lee, was amazing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的丈夫 Lee，他真的很棒。

sentences.en: We eventually had to hire a nanny, but we had not done that yet.
sentences.zh: 我们最终不得不请了一位保姆，但当时还没请。

sentences.en: We were like still figuring out how to swaddle.
sentences.zh: 我们当时还在研究怎么给孩子裹襁褓呢。

sentences.en: So for this episode, he came to work with me.
sentences.zh: 所以拍这一集的时候，他陪我一起去工作了。

sentences.en: He had our son in my trailer with him so that I could nurse him.
sentences.zh: 他带着我们的儿子在我的房车里，这样我就能给他喂奶。

sentences.en: Because like I said, I was still trying to get that down.
sentences.zh: 因为就像我说的，我当时还在努力适应哺乳这件事。

sentences.en: And I would have to shout out our first AD, Kelly Cantley, because she was instrumental
sentences.zh: 我必须得感谢我们的第一副导演 Kelly Cantley，因为她对

sentences.zh: 我没计划过，但我是在我们放暑假前一周生的孩子。

sentences.en: It just worked out like that.
So I had a little extra time there.

sentences.zh: 但我回去工作的第一周，我们就要拍全剧组的宣传照。

sentences.zh: 我能做到是因为片场的女性同胞们支持我。

sentences.zh: 我们以前也曾为别人拍电影安排过休假。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I went on unpaid disability, but the women in our casting crew, they filled in that gap.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我申请了无薪伤残假，但我们选角组的女性同事填补了这个空缺。

sentences.en: And that's why I was able to come back to work and get paid.
sentences.zh: 这就是我能重返工作岗位并拿到薪水的原因。

sentences.en: And I will be forever grateful.
We do that all the time for one another.
sentences.zh: 我们总是这样互相帮助。

sentences.en: I know every woman out there has a story about.
sentences.zh: 我知道每一位女性都有一个关于……的故事。

sentences.en: A woman that stood in for her.
sentences.zh: 关于一位曾为她代班的女性。
曾帮她渡过难关的女性。

sentences.en: So, thank you to Kelly and the hair and makeup women and Alicia in wardrobe and just you, Angela.
sentences.zh: 所以，感谢凯莉，感谢发型和化妆组的女士们，感谢服装组的艾丽西亚，还有你，安吉拉。

sentences.en: And listen, the other cast and crew were amazing as well.
sentences.zh: 听着，其他的演职人员也同样出色。

Well, let's take a quick break because when we come back, somebody's got to cut loose.

sentences.zh: 这一集开头，安迪冲进了楼梯顶端的仓库门。

sentences.zh: 瓦尔说，好吧，但一定要保证清理干净。

Well, I want you guys to know there was a deleted scene that would have started this episode

sentences.zh: 并交代安迪为什么会横冲直撞地穿过那个仓库

sentences.zh: 那是一段安迪早晨生活的蒙太奇剪辑。

sentences.en: He pulls into the parking lot and he spills coffee on his pants leg as he gets out of his
sentences.zh: 他把车开进停车场，下车时咖啡洒在了裤腿上，

sentences.en: Then he goes into the kitchen in the office and he gets a cup of coffee.
sentences.zh: 然后他走进办公室的厨房，去倒了一杯咖啡。

sentences.en: And he grabs some milk out of the fridge to add to his coffee.
sentences.zh: 他从冰箱里拿了些牛奶加进咖啡里。

sentences.zh: 倒的时候，牛奶盒里倒出了一大块一大块的凝块。

sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你要先往咖啡杯里倒牛奶，再倒咖啡。

sentences.en: Because then you can see the milk and also you don't need a spoon.
sentences.zh: 因为这样你能看清牛奶，而且也不需要勺子。

sentences.en: It mixes while you put the coffee in.
sentences.zh: 倒咖啡的时候它自己就混匀了。

sentences.en: This is a coffee drinker's hack I didn't know about.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我以前不知道的咖啡饮用小窍门。

sentences.en: Now he's super bummed because his first cup of coffee he spilled on his pants leg.
sentences.zh: 他现在超级沮丧，因为第一杯咖啡洒在了裤腿上，

sentences.en: The second cup is now full of this chunky milk.
sentences.zh: 第二杯现在又全是这种结块的牛奶。

sentences.en: Then he goes to get another cup of coffee.
sentences.zh: 然后他去拿另一杯咖啡。

sentences.en: He goes over to the coffee pot.
So then he goes into the freezer to grab the coffee grinds to make new coffee.
sentences.zh: 于是他去冷冻室拿咖啡粉准备煮新的咖啡。

sentences.zh: 他从冷冻室拿出袋子，结果是空的。

sentences.zh: 谁会把空袋子放回冷冻室？

sentences.en: Don't even bother going for that box.
sentences.zh: 别费劲去拿那个盒子了。

sentences.en: Then he leaves the kitchen in a huff with no coffee.
sentences.zh: 然后他气冲冲地离开了厨房，没喝到咖啡。

sentences.en: He's walking back towards his office.
sentences.zh: 他正走回自己的办公室。

sentences.en: And Aaron stops him and says, hey, you are getting a huge fax from corporate.
sentences.zh: 这时亚伦拦住他说，嘿，公司总部给你发来了一份超大的传真。

sentences.en: It's like 200 pages of forms you're going to need to fill out.
He's like, ah, and he goes to the warehouse.
sentences.zh: 他就像是，啊，然后就去了仓库。

sentences.en: After a morning like that, I would need to blow off steam with a mega dance.
sentences.zh: 经历过那样的一个上午，我肯定得跳场劲舞发泄一下。

sentences.en: You might need to mega dance.
sentences.zh: 你可能也需要跳场劲舞。

sentences.en: Yeah, you might need to dance on some of those little bubble poppet thingies.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你可能得去踩踩那些气泡膜。

sentences.en: Well, Andy is going to put Footloose on the boombox and he is going to do an epic dance montage.
sentences.zh: 嗯，安迪打算用音响放《浑身是劲》，然后来一段史诗级的舞蹈剪辑。

sentences.zh: 你知道吗，剧本里原本选的歌不是《浑身是劲》？

sentences.zh: 我们最后用了《浑身是劲》。

sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，安迪，听着《浑身是劲》跳舞让我想起了那个游戏，六度……

sentences.en: Okay, you guys know this, right?
sentences.zh: 好了，你们都知道这个吧？

sentences.en: The theory is that anyone can be linked through their film or TV roles back to Kevin Bacon
sentences.zh: 理论上讲，任何人都可以通过他们出演的电影或电视角色，在六步之内联系到凯文·贝肯。

sentences.en: You and I are two degrees from Kevin Bacon.
sentences.zh: 你和我距离凯文·贝肯只有两度。

sentences.en: Because Steve Carell and Kevin Bacon, we're both in Crazy Stupid Love.
sentences.zh: 因为史蒂夫·卡瑞尔和凯文·贝肯，我们都演了《疯狂愚蠢的爱》。

sentences.en: Wait, you don't count Kevin Bacon, I just realized.
sentences.zh: 等等，我刚意识到，你不能把凯文·贝肯算进去。

我们基本上算认识他了。

sentences.en: I would remember meeting Kevin Bacon.
sentences.zh: 如果我见过凯文·贝肯，我肯定会记得的。
凯文·贝肯，我们之间只差一度。

sentences.en: I feel like we could invite him over because we're one degree.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们可以邀请他过来，因为我们之间只差一度。

sentences.en: Can we just say, hey, you worked with someone we know.
sentences.zh: 我们可以直接说，嘿，你和我们认识的人合作过。

sentences.en: We got a fan question about this cold open from Haley B in Oklahoma who said,
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一位来自俄克拉荷马州的粉丝海莉·B发来的关于这段开场戏的问题，她问：

sentences.en: did Ed get to just have fun and do his own thing or was this all scripted?
sentences.zh: 艾德是随性发挥还是完全照着剧本演的？

sentences.en: Well, Steve Burgess said he does not have any choreographer on the schedule for this week.
sentences.zh: 嗯，史蒂夫·伯吉斯说他这周的日程表里没有安排任何编舞。

sentences.en: So he thinks that means the dancing was all Ed's creation.
sentences.zh: 所以他认为这意味着那段舞蹈完全是艾德自创的。

sentences.en: I did look in the script and there are very detailed stage directions for the dancing.
sentences.zh: 我查了一下剧本，上面确实有关于舞蹈非常详细的舞台指导。

sentences.zh: 剧本里包括了在大块气泡膜上跳踢踏舞。

sentences.zh: 还有，安迪在推车上玩滑板。

sentences.zh: 安迪还拿了一大袋碎纸，一边开心地大笑，一边制造出下雪的效果。

sentences.en: That was what was in the script.
Along with other things, there was a big liSt.
sentences.zh: 除了这些，还有一大堆内容。

sentences.en: So yeah, combo scripted Ed having fun, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得是剧本和艾德的即兴发挥相结合吧。

sentences.en: When I watched it, I really wish that I could run on that bubble wrap.
sentences.zh: 我看的时候，真希望自己也能在那层气泡膜上跑一跑。

sentences.en: That looked like fun to me.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那看起来很有趣。

sentences.en: I really wanted to dance on the paper confetti.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想在纸屑里跳舞。

sentences.en: I was super jealous when I watched this.
sentences.zh: 看这一段的时候我超级嫉妒。

sentences.en: I was like, I really wish this had been my cold open.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，真希望这是我的开场戏。
那一定是很开心的一天。

sentences.en: Well, this episode opens with Jim returning back to the office from jury duty.
sentences.zh: 这一集开头是吉姆结束陪审团义务回到办公室。

sentences.en: Everybody's very happy to see him.
They kind of want to know, like, how'd it go?
sentences.zh: 他们很想知道，比如，情况怎么样？

sentences.en: He says it was a hit and run.
sentences.zh: 他说是一起肇事逃逸案。

sentences.en: I was so intrigued by this.
sentences.zh: 我对这个情节非常好奇。

sentences.en: Why would Jim pick hit and run?
sentences.zh: 为什么吉姆选的是肇事逃逸案？

sentences.en: I don't know, because that feels like something that might have lasted a week.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，因为那听起来像是可能会持续一周的案子。
感觉像是个五天的庭审。

sentences.en: I mean, I guess you either did it or you didn't.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得要么就是你干的，要么就不是。

sentences.en: Yeah, but you got to present all the evidence.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但你得提交所有的证据。

sentences.en: Well, I was curious about, is this maybe something the writers knew about, like hit and run cases?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，编剧们是不是了解肇事逃逸案的情况？

sentences.en: And this is what I found.
In Pennsylvania, particularly in Philadelphia, hit and run accidents happen at an alarming rate.
sentences.zh: 在宾夕法尼亚州，尤其是费城，肇事逃逸事故的发生率高得惊人。

sentences.en: According to the AAA Foundation for Traffic Safety, hit and run accidents are a problem throughout the United States.
sentences.zh: 根据美国交通安全基金会的数据，肇事逃逸事故在美国各地都是一个问题。

sentences.en: Approximately 4.6 out of every 10,000 motorists have at least one prior hit and run violation, and more than one hit and run crash occurs every 60 seconds.
sentences.zh: 大约每10,000名驾驶员中就有4.6人至少有一次肇事逃逸的前科，而且每60秒就会发生一起以上的肇事逃逸事故。

sentences.en: I was at a hit and run.
sentences.zh: 我经历过一次肇事逃逸。
你成了统计数据的一部分。

sentences.en: I was in, like, a line of cars, and someone hit me, and then I hit the person in front of me, because, you know, they propelled me into them.
sentences.zh: 当时我大概是在车流里，有人撞了我，然后我撞到了前面那辆车，因为，你知道，他们把我顶到了前面那辆车上。

sentences.en: And we got out of our cars for a second, and then we signaled that we were all going to turn the corner to get off the main road.
sentences.zh: 我们下车看了一下，然后示意大家都转弯离开主路。

sentences.en: So, me and the person in front of me, we turned the corner to get off the main road, and then the hitter just took off.
sentences.zh: 所以，我和我前面的那个人转弯离开了主路，然后那个肇事者就直接跑了。

sentences.en: It's very common, so maybe that's why the writers were like, oh, this is an easy fit.
sentences.zh: 这很常见，所以也许这就是编剧们觉得，哦，这很容易写进去的原因。

sentences.en: You just took a buzz, and then you went, common.
sentences.zh: 你刚才愣了一下，然后说，常见。
你像个机器人一样说常见。

sentences.en: Did you know that you can get up to a year in prison or a fine up to $2,500, depending on the damage caused to the property in a hit and run?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，根据肇事逃逸造成的财产损失，你可能会面临最高一年的监禁或最高2,500美元的罚款？

sentences.en: So, it gets worse if the hit and run was worse, you know, the penalties.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果肇事逃逸的情况更严重，惩罚也会更重，你知道的。

sentences.en: We might need to take a coffee break for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们可能需要休息一下，喝杯咖啡了。

sentences.en: Well, Jim has a talking head where he says that he was called into jury duty, but they released him around noon.
sentences.zh: 嗯，吉姆有个访谈片段，他说他被传唤去当陪审员，但他们中午左右就让他走了。

sentences.en: He didn't see any point in going back to work for just a half day, so he, you know, stayed home that day, helped Pam.
sentences.zh: 他觉得只上半天班没意义，所以他那天就待在家里，帮帕姆忙。

sentences.en: Then he took the next day off to help Pam, and then three other days happened.
sentences.zh: 然后他又请了第二天假去帮帕姆，接着又过了三天。

sentences.en: I also thought John did such a great job, his look at the end.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得约翰演得太棒了，尤其是他最后那个眼神。

sentences.en: So, Anne, you looked up the statistics of hit and runs.
sentences.zh: 所以，安，你查了肇事逃逸的统计数据。

sentences.en: I looked up the statistics for how likely it is that you'll get picked for a jury.
sentences.zh: 我查了被选中担任陪审员的概率统计。

sentences.en: Because I seem to get picked every time.
sentences.zh: 因为我好像每次都被选中。

sentences.en: So, according to the National Center for State Courts, it estimates that in any given year, 32 million people get summoned for jury duty.
sentences.zh: 根据国家州法院中心的数据估计，每年大约有3200万人收到陪审团传票。

sentences.en: But only 8 million of them actually report.
sentences.zh: 但实际上只有800万人去报到。
他们怎么会不去报到呢？

sentences.en: Well, they said there's, like, millions of jury summons that get returned because the person isn't at that address anymore.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们说有几百万份陪审团传票被退回，因为收件人已经不在那个地址了。

sentences.en: There's a bunch of people that, you know, get out for certain reasons.
sentences.zh: 还有很多人，你知道的，因为某些原因被豁免了。

sentences.en: So, of the 32 million that they send out, 8 million report for jury duty, and of that 8 million, 1.5 people get selected to serve.
sentences.zh: 所以，在发出的3200万份传票中，有800万人去报到，而这800万人中，有150万人被选中参加陪审团。

sentences.en: That means you have a roughly 19 percent chance of getting selected for a jury.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你被选中参加陪审团的几率大约是19%。
如果800万人里有150万人的话。

sentences.en: How do I continue to fall into the 19 percent?
